screen: SEASON STATS — RECEIVING, scope NATIONAL, sorted by YARDS descending
method: Eleven columns across two recordings. IMG_5212 carries GP through DROPS, IMG_5213 repeats YARDS rightwards and adds SNAPS. Both keep the NAME column, so the merge is checked on name and receiving yards together at every row; all 400 matched.
validation: Three identities hold on all 400 rows: AVG is yards per reception, AVG G yards per game, RAC AVG yards after catch per reception. The merge between the two screens is additionally pinned by the repeated YARDS column.
teams: No team column; the labels inherited from the earlier pass are kept.
list_length: 400 players — the same cap as the defensive and rushing lists, ending at K.Reynolds on 482 yards.
